summary: Iteration 10 verified the new Non-Kubernetes Workloads feature (backend + frontend) and the AWS test-connection / tag-options additions. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases passed covering full workload CRUD (create/list/get/update/delete admin-only), 404, preview + generate endpoints returning config_json + all 6 files (provider.tf, variables.tf, main.tf, outputs.tf, terraform.tfvars.json, userdata.sh.tpl) with correct nodes/data_volumes/ingress_ports, AWS test-connection returning ok:false + real ClientError with invalid saved creds, GET /api/aws/tag-options returning `mode` field (demo), and POST /api/aws/discover returning demo resources. Frontend: end-to-end wizard flow — login, nav-workloads, 4-step stepper with Next/Back and step buttons, DNS switch shows/hides Private Zone Name field, ingress_ports accepts comma-separated ports, presets (Add web) + wl-add-node-button both add cards (final count 4), Add-volume + volume-type dropdown (io2) work, Save (Create) persists and appears in workload-select, load-saved repopulates form, admin delete + wl-confirm-delete removes it, generate produces all 7 file tabs and wl-download-all button. Team page AWS Connection card shows configured + DEMO badges plus yellow live-discovery-off warning; Test Connection call shows 'Failed: ClientError: The security token included in the request is invalid.' in aws-test-result. Dashboard code confirmed to include rds_db type card.
critical_code_review_comments: workloads_generator.py + k8s_generator.py share very similar Terraform template scaffolding — could be DRYed into a helper, but not blocking.
server.py Workload/K8sCluster CRUD endpoints are near-duplicates; a small mixin/factory would remove repetition, but readability is fine.
Workloads.jsx is ~540 lines; still manageable, but consider extracting NodeCard/VolumeRow/Stepper into their own files if it grows further.
Live AWS discovery could not be exercised (no valid creds); happy path only covered by unit-testable code paths — recommend adding a live-mode smoke test in a real AWS sandbox before shipping.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted TEST_workload_1 during CRUD tests; UI test created 'app-workload' (template) then deleted it. DB left clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Workloads feature (backend + wizard UI) is fully validated. Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_workloads.py covers CRUD + preview + generate + AWS test-connection/tag-options/discover. Live AWS remains unverified by design (no real creds). data-testids in Workloads.jsx match the spec exactly.
